ModMetaData.author: F.A.F. contributors
ModMetaData.description:
F.A.F. — Fridges Absolutely Fly. An extension for N.S.I.F. (Nivarian Sleep In Fridges).
The Nivarian engineering team has reviewed the household refrigerator and identified an unnecessary dependency: the floor.
Complete Project T.O.F.U to let fridges recognised by Nivarian Sleep In Fridges hover and rotate in place. Sleeping Nivarians need not interrupt their rest for this adjustment. Hover and rotation have separate controls; the equipment levels itself before touching down.
A transparent Nivarian household freezer and a portable sleeping pad are also supplied. Further improvements belong to SPICE—Storage Preservation and Integrated Cooling Engineering—a programme devoted to better preservation, dependable power and more manageable household equipment.
Each seasoning-named project comes with a practical upgrade, a material requisition and an entirely serious technical report. Any suggestion that the final specification exceeds ordinary kitchen requirements should be directed to the engineering team.
